title: 第167章 时间恢复第166章 争执不休
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
晏灼华在屋子里气得直跺脚，漂亮的眉眼拧成一团，胸腔里的怒火几乎要烧穿天灵盖。他明明布下了局，却还是被月临寒那厮金蝉脱壳，眼睁睁看着对方带着宁苒苒的气息消失在眼前，这种功亏一篑的憋屈让他恨不得把手里的茶杯捏碎。
就在他原地无能狂怒，抬脚踹向旁边的雕花桌腿时，眼角余光骤然瞥见了不远处的宁苒苒。
少女正站着，还维持着刚刚被定住的姿势。时间仿佛定格，冻结了一切。
晏灼华眸色一沉，计上心头，原本紧绷的唇角缓缓勾起一抹笑，那笑容里满是算计。他压低声音，带着几分戏谑与得意，对着月临寒离开的方向开口：“月临寒，你跑了又如何？你以为躲得掉吗？只要我待在宁苒苒身边，寸步不离，还愁你不现身吗？”
言罢，他打了个清脆的响指，指尖的动作带着刻意的停顿。
下一秒，周遭凝滞的空气仿佛突然被解开了枷锁，时间恢复了正常的流速。晏灼华的身影瞬间化作细碎的粉色光点，如同被风吹散的桃花瓣，轻飘飘地飘向小舞的头顶，重新嵌入了那支精致的桃花发卡之中，光点微闪，便没了动静。
宁苒苒猛地回过神，意识从混沌中抽离。
因为时间的定格，被定住的人根本不会有意识，所以她只能记得上一秒，晏灼华和那道神秘的月临寒还在她面前争执不休，言语间的寒意几乎要将她包裹，下一秒两人就凭空消失，只留下空气中残留的、若有若无的气息。
再抬眼望去，周围原本僵住的小伙伴们都恢复了正常的模样，奥斯卡揉着肚子嘟囔着什么，马红俊拍着大腿笑闹，小舞正低头把玩着头上的发卡。
宁苒苒的心轻轻一沉，脑海中瞬间闪过一个念头。
无非就是有什么秘密是她不该听的，所以方才，有人暂停了她的时间。
众人确实都恢复了意识，只是不知为何，每个人的心底都隐隐掠过一丝异样——总觉得刚刚好像有那么一瞬间，时间像是被按了暂停键，周遭的一切都卡了一下，快得让人抓不住，却又真实存在。
不过这点微小的违和感很快就被接下来的热闹冲散，没人放在心上。
“给，苒苒。”
一道温和的声音自身侧响起，打断了宁苒苒纷乱的思绪。她抬眼，便看到唐三端着一块精致的小蛋糕走了过来，白瓷盘子衬得蛋糕上的奶油更显细腻，点缀的草莓鲜红饱满，看着就让人食指大动。
“啊？哦哦，谢谢三哥！”宁苒苒愣了好半晌才反应过来，连忙伸手接过，指尖触到微凉的瓷盘，小声地道谢。她的声音里还带着方才未散的茫然，脸颊微微泛红。
“我看你晚上好像没怎么吃，怕你饿了。”唐三的目光落在她略显苍白的小脸上，眼神里满是担忧，“这块蛋糕是我特意去膳房挑的，味道挺好的，尝尝看。”
宁苒苒握着小蛋糕，心里暖暖的，忍不住微微一笑。
心里暗想：三哥果然一如既往的体贴细心，总能敏锐地察觉到她的小情绪。她咬了一口蛋糕，甜而不腻的奶油在舌尖化开，却压不住心底那一丝复杂。
目光不自觉地飘向小舞的头顶，落在那支精致的桃花发卡上——粉色的花瓣雕得栩栩如生，花蕊处还嵌着细碎的光点，和方才晏灼华化作的光点一模一样。

她的心猛地一揪，心绪翻涌得厉害。
月临寒走了，不知道晏灼华是不是也跟着走了？这个念头刚在心底升起，小舞头上的桃花发卡上，原本沉寂的粉色光点突然闪动了几下，像是某种无声的回应，又像是在昭示着什么。
宁苒苒：……
好了，破案了，这个讨人厌的家伙还没有走︶︿︶
“苒苒，怎么了吗？”
唐三察觉到她的异样，顺着她的目光看过去，发现她的视线一直黏在小舞头上的发卡上，不由得轻声问道。他顺着她的视线看了看那支发卡，又收回目光，侧过身来，语气带着几分温柔的哄劝：“是喜欢这个发卡吗？”
宁苒苒回过神，连忙摇摇头，却被他看得心底发慌。
唐三笑了笑，眼底带着宠溺的柔光：“等下次我们放假的时候，我带你去集市里逛逛，你喜欢什么样的，我给你买一个，好不好？”
听到唐三的话，宁苒苒终于收回了落在发卡上的目光，重新抬眼看向他，轻轻摇了摇头，声音软了下来：“不用了三哥，马上就要到我们上场比赛了。你紧张吗？”
她刻意转移了话题，不想让唐三察觉到她的异样。
唐三坦然回之，眼神坚定，语气里满是自信：“说实话，我并不紧张。”他伸手拍了拍宁苒苒的肩膀，目光扫过身边的伙伴们，每一个人的脸上都带着跃跃欲试的光芒，“我相信我们，现在的史莱克，实力不比任何一个队伍差。我有这个信心，今晚赢的一定是我们。”
“啪啪啪——”
清脆的拍手声突然响起，打断了唐三的话。
众人循声望去，只见大师正站在不远处，双手背在身后，脸上带着一贯的严肃，却又藏着一丝不易察觉的赞许。他轻轻拍手，将所有人的注意力都吸引了过去。
“好了，都别松懈。”大师的声音不大，却带着不容置疑的威严，“比赛马上就要开始了，史莱克的各位，拿出你们的实力，让所有人都看看，我们史莱克学院的厉害。”
话音落下，宁苒苒握紧了手里的小蛋糕，抬头看向身边的唐三。少年的眼神明亮如星，映着赛场的灯光，也映着她心底的忐忑与期待。她深吸一口气，将蛋糕递还给唐三，眼底的茫然尽数褪去，取而代之的是坚定的光芒。
“走吧，三哥。”
唐三接过蛋糕，笑着点头，伸手牵住她的手腕，温暖的掌心传来踏实的触感。
史莱克七怪并肩走向赛场，身后是众人的加油声，身前是未知的挑战。而小舞头上的桃花发卡，粉色的光点轻轻闪烁。
content_en:
Yan Zhuohua was so angry that he stamped his feet in the room, his beautiful eyebrows knitted together, and the anger in his chest almost burned through Tianling Gai. He had clearly laid out a plan, but he was still thrown out of his shell by Yue Linhan's fellow Jin Chan. He watched helplessly as the opponent disappeared in front of him with Ning Ranran's aura. The frustration of not succeeding made him want to crush the tea cup in his hand.
Just as he was furious and helpless, raising his foot to kick the carved table leg next to him, he suddenly caught a glimpse of Ning Ranran not far away from the corner of his eye.
The girl was standing, still maintaining the posture she had just been frozen in. Time seemed to freeze, freezing everything.
Yan Zhuohua's eyes darkened, and the plan came to mind. The corners of his originally tight lips slowly raised into a smile, and that smile was full of calculations. He lowered his voice, with a bit of teasing and pride, and spoke in the direction where Yue Linhan left: "Yue Linhan, what if you run away? Do you think you can escape? As long as I stay by Ning Ranran's side and never leave, do I still worry about you not showing up?"
After saying this, he snapped his fingers crisply, with a deliberate pause in the movement of his fingertips.
The next second, the stagnant air around him seemed to be suddenly unchained, and time returned to its normal flow rate. Yan Zhuohua's figure instantly turned into tiny pink light spots, like peach blossom petals blown away by the wind, floating lightly to Xiao Wu's head, and re-embedded into the delicate peach blossom hairpin. The light spots flickered slightly, and then there was no movement.
Ning Ranran suddenly came back to her senses, and her consciousness was withdrawn from the chaos.
Because of the freezing of time, the person who was frozen would not be conscious at all, so she could only remember the last second when Yan Zhuohua and the mysterious Yue Linhan were still arguing in front of her. The chill in their words almost enveloped her. The next second, the two of them disappeared out of thin air, leaving only the lingering, vague breath in the air.
Looking up again, the friends who had been frozen all around him had returned to their normal appearance. Oscar was rubbing his belly and mumbling something, Ma Hongjun was slapping his thigh and laughing, and Xiao Wu was lowering his head and playing with the hairpins on his head.
Ning Ranran's heart sank slightly, and a thought flashed through her mind.
It's just that there are some secrets that she shouldn't hear, so just now, someone paused her time.
Everyone did regain consciousness, but for some reason, something strange flashed through everyone's heart - it felt as if for a moment, time had been pressed on the pause button, and everything around them was stuck. It was so fast that people couldn't catch it, but it was real.
However, this slight sense of disobedience was quickly washed away by the excitement that followed, and no one took it to heart.
"Here, Ran Ran."
A gentle voice sounded from beside him, interrupting Ning Ranran's chaotic thoughts. She raised her eyes and saw Tang San walking over with a piece of delicate little cake. The white porcelain plate made the cream on the cake even more delicate, and the garnished strawberries were bright red and plump, making people move their index fingers just looking at it.
"Ah? Oh, thank you, third brother!" Ning Ranran was stunned for a long time before she realized what she was doing. She quickly reached out and took it, her fingertips touching the slightly cold porcelain plate, and whispered her thanks. There was still confusion in her voice, and her cheeks were slightly red.
"I see that you didn't eat much at night, I'm afraid you might be hungry." Tang San's eyes fell on her slightly pale face, his eyes full of worry, "I went to the dining room to pick out this cake. It tastes quite good. Try it."
Ning Ranran held the small cake in her hands, feeling warm in her heart and couldn't help but smile.
I thought to myself: Third brother is indeed as considerate and attentive as ever, and can always be keenly aware of her little emotions. She took a bite of the cake, and the sweet but not greasy cream melted on her tongue, but she couldn't suppress the complexity in her heart.
His eyes drifted unconsciously to the top of Xiao Wu's head, and landed on the delicate peach blossom hairpin - the pink petals were carved lifelike, and there were tiny light spots embedded in the stamens, which were exactly the same as the light spots transformed into by Yan Zhuohua just now.
Her heart suddenly tugged, and her emotions surged violently.
Yue Linhan is gone, I don’t knowDid Yan Zhuohua also follow? As soon as this thought arose in her heart, the originally silent pink light spots on the peach blossom hairpin on Xiao Wu's head suddenly flashed a few times, like some kind of silent response, and also seemed to indicate something.
Ning Ranran:......
Okay, the case has been solved, this annoying guy hasn’t left yet︶︿︶
"Ranran, what's wrong?"
Tang San noticed something strange about her, followed her gaze, and found that her gaze had been glued to the hairpin on Xiao Wu's head, and couldn't help but ask softly. He followed her line of sight and looked at the hairpin, then looked away, turned sideways, and said with a gentle coaxing tone: "Do you like this hairpin?"
Ning Ranran came back to her senses and shook her head quickly, but he saw that she was panicking in her heart.
Tang San smiled, with a soft light of endearment in his eyes: "When we have a holiday next time, I will take you to the market. What kind of thing do you like? I will buy you one, okay?"
Hearing Tang San's words, Ning Ranran finally retracted her gaze from the hairpin, raised her eyes to look at him again, shook her head gently, and softened her voice: "No need, Third Brother, we will be playing the game soon. Are you nervous?"
She deliberately changed the topic, not wanting Tang San to notice anything strange about her.
Tang San replied calmly, his eyes were firm, and his tone was full of confidence: "To be honest, I'm not nervous." He reached out and patted Ning Ranran's shoulder, and glanced at the partners around him. Everyone's face was filled with eagerness to try, "I believe that our current Shrek's strength is no worse than any other team. I have this confidence that we will win tonight."
"Pah, pah, pah—"
The clear sound of clapping suddenly sounded, interrupting Tang San's words.
Everyone followed the sound and saw the master standing not far away, with his hands behind his back, his face always serious, but with a trace of unnoticeable approval hidden in it. He clapped his hands gently, attracting everyone's attention.
"Okay, don't relax." The master's voice was not loud, but it was full of unquestionable majesty. "The competition is about to begin. Everyone from Shrek, show your strength and let everyone see how powerful our Shrek Academy is."
After finishing her words, Ning Ranran clenched the small cake in her hand and looked up at Tang San beside her. The young man's eyes were as bright as stars, reflecting the lights of the arena, as well as the anxiety and expectation in her heart. She took a deep breath and handed the cake back to Tang San. The confusion in her eyes faded away, replaced by a determined light.
"Let's go, third brother."
Tang San took the cake, nodded with a smile, stretched out his hand to hold her wrist, and felt a solid touch in his warm palm.
The Shrek Seven Devils walked side by side to the arena, with the cheers of the crowd behind them and the unknown challenges in front of them. As for the peach blossom hairpin on Xiao Wu's head, pink light spots flickered gently.
